steps.name: Provider accepted workflow and materialized job

gap.missing_field: minimal semantic class that reproduces jobs=0 pre-job failure
gap.blocking_dependency: incremental diagnostic workflow has not yet introduced suspect semantic classes
gap.evidence_needed: first diagnostic increment whose run changes from materialized-success to pre-job failure, followed by single-variable confirmation
gap.falsifier: all suspect semantic classes materialize successfully in isolated probes
gap.next_probe: extend the audit-only diagnostic workflow with exactly one suspect class while retaining the successful provider-minimal control
gap.closure_gate: reproducible minimal failing semantic delta or explicit provider diagnostic

memory_projection.L: minimal probe created -> run materialized -> job executed -> success
memory_projection.O: generic ci jobs=0 coexists with successful minimal workflow in same repository
memory_projection.T: GitHub provider basic acceptance separated from generic-ci semantic surface
memory_projection.C: basic push workflow is provider-valid; generic CI cause remains unresolved

uncertainty_before: minimal provider result unknown + generic-ci semantic cause unknown
uncertainty_after: basic provider acceptance reproduced; generic-ci semantic cause remains TOKEN_VAZIO
coverage_after: diagnostic source + run + suite + job + step conclusions
F_ok: lineage extended through job and steps
F_next: introduce exactly one provider-semantic suspect class into an audit-only diagnostic successor and compare against this successful control
